protocol.selection: Rerun all three families and maximum-over-three frozen trigram models for each positive and each null; identical mask, limits and fixed score threshold.
protocol.threshold_scope: Researcher-chosen before these outcomes; an illustrative empirical exceedance rate under specified shuffles, not a calibrated authenticity threshold.
nonclaims: Not a real-world false-positive probability or authenticity estimate.
Families were engineered using clue positions to guarantee competition, before scoring.
Not a representative multilingual corpus; all outcomes and censoring must be retained.

structure.scope: The24 masked originals occupy24 distinct key slots in every declared model; every crib RHS is feasible. Differing free-direction spans/cardinalities guarantee inequivalent affine sets independently of scoring.

protocol.scope: Finite ordinal K4-cell path hypotheses; mechanical known-plaintext control, not a K4 search. Shape-only development preflight already checked counts; no language scores are used.
protocol.known_positions: all97 original positions, artificial supplied plaintext for route/constraint/replay control
protocol.comparison: Solve every bijective raw tuple and then every unique route. Compare classifications/candidate sets and algebra operation counts; reject invalid paths and merge aliases before cipher search.

generated.interpretation: Complete declared parameter product; trapped walks rejected and identical bijections merged before cipher work. Coordinates are transcription ordinals, not measured3D geometry or an authenticated Kryptos mechanism.

grid_paths.interpretation: Fewer cipher constraint calls on this finite parameter set, preserving every distinct route and exact answer. No claim of fewer steps for every grid or of a recovered sculpture path.

controls.interpretation: Descriptive bounded selection controls, not solution confidence or a false-positive probability.

cases.source: Authored for phase O before scoring; ASCII uppercase first97 letters; not a representative corpus. Synthetic clue-aware routes deliberately ensure distinct surviving families.

calibration.selection_scope: Every trial reruns every bank family and frozen scoring model with the same limits; maximum score across the full bank is assessed.
calibration.interpretation: Descriptive frequency under these fixed conditional shuffles and procedure; not an authenticity probability, p-value, or population false-positive rate. Incomplete trials suppress the full-protocol rate.

nonclaims: No authenticated Kryptos decipherment or external submission.
Frozen authored controls are not a representative language population or a false-positive probability.
Wall time is cooperative between algebra/candidate steps; use the app's hard worker deadline.
Different model parameterizations may overlap; candidate texts are merged, model aliases retained.
Truth recovery/rank is an observed outcome, not a required success threshold.
The finite engineered family bank and conditional shuffles do not estimate real-world authenticity.
No K4/K5 decipherment, arbitrary path search, or measured3D geometry claim.
